[[Viridian City]] }} '''Forretress of Solitude''' (Japanese: '''VS フォレトス ''' ''VS {{tt|Foretos|Forretress}}''), titled '''VS Forretress''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 115th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 25th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Yellow}} and [[Daisy Oak]] are trying to reason with {{adv|Red}}, saying that there is no way that he can recover by tomorrow. Red argues, saying that he can't back down, as tomorrow is his aptitude test for becoming the [[Viridian Gym]] Leader. He quickly ushers his Pokémon away for more training, leaving Yellow and Daisy speechless. Later, Red is on the video phone with {{adv|Bill}}, talking about how "tomorrow's the day". Red then gets a knock at the door, revealing [[Brock]] and [[Misty]] with their aptitude test videos and an instruction manual. Red thanks them as Brock asks if he is ready. Red replies by showing off his muscles, and Brock and Misty leave. That night, Red lays awake in bed, thinking about the next day. He worries about his wrists, and thinks that he'll need a plan, if the numbness does kick in during the test. The next day, Red stands in the stadium, with all six of his Pokémon out, and the crowd cheering. The announcer explains the rules briefly, then announces the start of the test. Red's first opponent is a {{p|Pineco}}, which [[Saur]] swiftly knocks out, as well as its next two opponents, a {{p|Forretress}} and another Pineco. However, the fourth opponent, another Forretress, resorts to its {{m|Spikes}} and is putting up a fair fight against Saur. Red commands Saur to use {{m|Sweet Scent}}, then promptly switches it out for [[Snor]], whom is commanded to use {{m|Belly Drum}}. As the crowd wonders what Red is doing, Snor's {{m|Belly Drum}} causes the Spikes to rebound and are sent back to Forretress, as well as a {{m|Mega Punch}}. Because of Saur's Sweet Scent, Forretress's movements were slowed down, which helped Red knock it out. Red's next opponent is an {{p|Azumarill}}, who promptly uses {{m|Whirlpool}}, surrounding Red and Snor. As Red desperately tries to think of a solution and has Snor use {{m|Rest}} to heal, his numbness, aggravated by the water, starts to kick in. Yellow and Daisy notice that something is wrong. The Whirlpool subsides, and Snor quickly uses {{m|Mega Kick}}, knocking Azumarill out. Red's last opponent is a {{p|Porygon2}}, and he sends out his {{p|Espeon}}, [[Vee]]. Red and Vee are seen briefly in Porygon2's field of vision as it targets them with {{m|Lock-On}} and fires a {{m|Zap Cannon}}, reducing Vee's [[HP]] to below half. However, Red remains confident, as he commands Vee to use {{m|Morning Sun}}, followed by {{m|Psychic}}. This knocks Porygon2 out, and thus Red wins the test and gains the position of Viridian [[Gym Leader]]. However, as he is being congratulated, he declines the position. He says that throughout the match, he realized that he was still not good enough to be a Gym Leader. This saddens the citizens of [[Viridian City]], as they wonder who their new Leader will be. Meanwhile, {{adv|Blue}} is seen in the shadows with his {{TP|Blue|Scizor}}. ==Major events== * {{adv|Red}} starts the test to become [[Viridian City]]'s [[Gym Leader]]. * Red's {{p|Eevee}}, [[Vee]], is revealed to have permanently evolved into {{p|Espeon}}. * {{adv|Blue}}'s {{p|Scyther}} is revealed to have evolved into {{TP|Blue|Scizor}}. * Red passes the test to become Viridian City's Gym Leader, but declines the position. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Espeon}} * {{p|Porygon2}} * {{p|Azumarill}} * {{p|Forretress}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Bill}} * [[Brock]] * [[Misty]] * [[Daisy Oak]] * [[Wilton]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Poli]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Snorlax}} ([[Snor]]; {{Adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Espeon}} ([[Vee]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Gyara]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Scizor}} ({{OP|Blue|Scizor}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Chuchu]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Porygon2}} ([[Pokémon Association]]'s) * {{p|Pineco}} ([[Pokémon Association]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Forretress}} ([[Pokémon Association]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Azumarill}} ([[Pokémon Association]]'s) * {{p|Charizard}} (poster) ==Trivia== * The [[VIZ Media]] title of this chapter is a pun on {{wp|Superman}}'s {{wp|Fortress of Solitude}}. ===Errors=== * In the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese}} translation, "{{tt|suas Poké Bolas|their Poké Balls}}" is misspelled as "{{tt|suas Poké Bola|their Poké Ball}}". ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 佛烈託斯|VS Forretress}} (Taiwan)
